subsets.note: Conservative exclusion: eval-only, hard-excluded from training (data-strategy 硬约束 5). The creators' dataset card declares CC BY 4.0, but the constituent paper full texts carry per-document 'CC-BY-*' variants (Unpaywall/S2ORC, incl. NC/SA family members) that cannot be verified per row from the LongBench distribution — per-document variance is structural, so the recorded CC BY-NC precedent stands. Revisit only with a license-mapped QASPER download.
